title: Next run of a weekday time-of-day schedule
task: In package `schedule`, given a daily time of day (hour and minute) and a set of weekdays, compute `Next`: the first scheduled run at or after a given instant, in that instant's location. If the instant is exactly on a scheduled time, that instant is the answer. A Sundays-only schedule and a Friday 17:00 schedule asked on a Friday at 17:01 are the cases I care about most. Keep the search readable: no single function should do both the day walking and the time-of-day arithmetic.
